big: India's defence policy gives top priority to equipment that is indigenously designed, developed and manufactured. That is the Buy (Indian-IDDM) category, and it is what moves orders to Indian firms.

lines: DAP 2020 gives top priority to Buy (Indian-IDDM). Positive indigenisation lists bar imports of hundreds of items after set timelines. FDI in defence is allowed up to 74% by the automatic route and up to 100% with government approval. Defence corridors in UP and Tamil Nadu cluster manufacturing.
